liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Intrasport**: rare: 10 archived performances [6]
- **Antartica**: rare: 5 archived performances [6]
- **Hog Calling Contest**: rare: 9 archived performances [6]

## The recordings

- **kglw2024-11-12.InsideOut_AKGck63.Matrix** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 17 songs; 149 min [1]
- **kglw2024-11-12.dpa2012**: source not stated; 17 songs; 149 min [2]
- **kglw2024-11-12.InsideOut_AKGck63**: source not stated; 17 songs; 149 min [3]
- **kglw2024-11-12**: source not stated; 3 songs; 149 min [4]

## Around the show

- Taper HealthCov Chris recorded from left of SBD cage, 55 feet from stage [1]
- Plastic Boogie included Hypertension and Land Before Timeland teases; Straws In The Wind quoted Iggy Pop [2]
- Band shouted out Nathan, their synth table nickname, after Extinction; Hog Calling Contest teased Antarctica [2]
- Taper HealthCov Chris recorded from left of SBD cage, 55 feet from stage [3]
- Taper ted chopped xlrs recorded from left corner of FOH, 100 feet from stage [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **kglw2024-11-12.InsideOut_AKGck63.Matrix**: taped by HealthCov Chris; transferred by InsideOut Recording; source: AKG ck63 + SBD > Zoom F3 [1]. Also: AKG ck63 mics fed into Nbob actives and Naiant pfa, recorded on Zoom F3 [1]
- **kglw2024-11-12.dpa2012**: taped by Jimmy Lu (umamibeat); transferred by Jimmy Lu (umamibeat); source: DPA 2012 > Zoom F3 [2]. Also: Matched DPA 2012 pair in ORTF configuration captured onto a Zoom F3 recorder [2]
- **kglw2024-11-12.InsideOut_AKGck63**: taped by HealthCov Chris; transferred by InsideOut Recording; source: AKG ck63 (PAS) > Nbob actives > Naiant pfa > Zoom F3 [3]
- **kglw2024-11-12**: taped by puffanug; transferred by puffanug; source: ADK THORs > PMD661 > 24/96wav [4]. Also: ADK T7 THORs in ORTF at FOB, recorded on Oade modded Marantz PMD661 [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Reverholic: [King Gizzard And The Lizard Wizard Poster For Show In Oklahoma City Oklahoma In The Criterionin On November 12 2024 Home](https://reverholic.com/product/king-gizzard-and-the-lizard-wizard-poster-for-show-in-oklahoma-city-oklahoma-in-the-criterionin-on-november-12-2024-home-decor-poster-canvas/) [7]
- Poster by Reverholic: [King Gizzard And The Lizard Wizard Poster For Show In Oklahoma City Oklahoma In The Criterionin On November 12 2024 All ](https://reverholic.com/product/king-gizzard-and-the-lizard-wizard-poster-for-show-in-oklahoma-city-oklahoma-in-the-criterionin-on-november-12-2024-all-over-print-shirt/) [8]
